workshops.name: Tyrian Royal Purple Dye Installation
workshops.craft: Enzymatic biochemical pigment synthesis and luxury textile dyeing
workshops.pedagogicalSafety: Child-safe color chemistry and pigment matching; zero animal cruelty depicted or required
exhibitComponents: Lead boiling vats and stone crushing basins for mollusk shells
Salt crystallization and sunlight photo-oxidation drying racks
Color spectrum display: yellow precursor turning green, then vibrant deep dibromoindigo crimson under sunlight
Textile swatches of royal robes, linen tunics, and Phoenician merchant sails
workshops.learningObjective: Understand how sunlight converts pale snail secretions into the ancient world's most lightfast and valuable imperial dye.

workshops.name: Sidonian Core-Formed Glass Atelier
workshops.nativeName: مشغل صيدا لتشكيل الزجاج على القوالب الرملية
workshops.craft: Hot-glass manipulation, core-forming, and thread trailing
workshops.pedagogicalSafety: Safe styling puzzle using colored vitreous filaments; non-hazardous simulation
exhibitComponents: Clay and dung core on a metal mandrel
Crucibles of cobalt, copper, and manganese fluxed molten glass
Feathered combing tools creating zigzag chevron patterns
Cooling lehr pit for controlled annealing
workshops.learningObjective: Discover how Sidon artisans invented vessel making prior to the blowpipe by dragging molten colored threads across revolving clay cores.

workshops.name: Phoenician Weighing & Exchange Bureau
workshops.pedagogicalSafety: Mathematical balance and trade fraction mechanics
exhibitComponents: Dual-pan bronze scale with bronze lion and dome stone weights
Phoenician shekel (7.6g) and mina (50 shekels) metric converters
Silver bullion ingots (hacksilver) and minted tetradrachms
Maritime trade ledger in Phoenician cursive script
workshops.learningObjective: Learn how the Mediterranean's first international currency system used standardized precious metal weights before uniform coins were struck.
